Title: Confirm it is you
Intro: This action protects your account. Confirm with a passkey of this account to continue.
IntroPassword: This action protects your account. Confirm with this account's password to continue.
IntroRecovery: This action protects your account. Confirm with a recovery code of this account to continue.
BrowserSignInIntro: Sign in again to confirm it is you. The action continues right after.
PasskeyFailed: The passkey prompt did not complete. Try again, or use another way to confirm.
ErrorMissing: Please confirm with a passkey, your password or a recovery code.
ErrorTooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
ErrorNetwork: The server could not be reached.
ErrorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ApprovalOtherSession: A new passkey cannot be approved from the session that added it. Approve it on another signed-in device, or sign out and sign in again with an existing passkey or your password, then approve it here.
